outlet: Journal of the San Juan Islands, 'Voters reject levy lid lift: County faces hard choices ahead', Darrell Kirk, May 4, 2026
notes: April 28, 2026 county levy lid lift (to $0.85 per $1,000, about $4.5 million a year) failed 3,914 to 2,528; $3.7 million gap for 2027; Lopez 55.4% no, Shaw 53.8% no. Assessor John Kulseth on assessments and the senior exemption.
